records.rationale: An exclusion over two Feature source kinds deacon's lockfile writer cannot reach: `upgrade` skips `./`, `../` and `/` identifiers before resolution because a local Feature has no OCI identity to record (crates/deacon/src/commands/upgrade.rs::resolve_lockfile_from_config), and `validate_lockfile` requires every `resolved` value to be a valid OCI reference, so a non-OCI entry cannot exist in a lockfile deacon writes. The clause forbids a state the writer cannot produce, so it adds nothing separately observable to bhv-upgrade-regenerates-lockfile's whole-document assertion.

The lowercasing is stated as a lookup convenience over identifiers that are OCI repository references, which the distribution spec already constrains to lowercase; deacon records the identifier the author wrote (upgrade.rs::resolve_lockfile_from_config) and a reference that is not already lowercase does not resolve at the registry, so no reachable configuration makes the normalization separately observable from the recorded keys bhv-upgrade-regenerates-lockfile already compares.
